Tests that LLM max_concurrency is accepted independently of the extraction thread budget

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, CaptioningConfig, ConcurrencyConfig, ExtractionConfig, LlmConfig, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="text/plain", uri="https://example.com/text/report.txt")
    config = ExtractionConfig(captioning=CaptioningConfig(llm=LlmConfig(max_concurrency=2, model="openai/gpt-4o"), min_image_area=1000), concurrency=ConcurrencyConfig(max_threads=8))
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
